item.description:

  • スコア: 7.13/10 (153 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺の瞳で丸裸！不可知な未来と視透かす運命
  • 英語名: Ore no Hitomi de Maruhadaka! Fukachi na Mirai to Misukasu Vision

别名

  • Orefukachi

あらすじ

“Oh, my. It’s been a long time since we have a guest.”

“For now, this is how it’s gonna be.

Anything you like over there, just one, you can take it with you.”

In the suburbs, deep in the forest, lies the “Witch’s House.” When they were young, a group of six childhood friends successfully visited the place. Each of them were given and took home, magical items. However―― Only one boy was different.

item.title: Deatte 5-fun wa Ore no Mono! Jikan Teishi to Atropos
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hulotte
  • 発売日: 2018-10-26
  • スコア: 7.4/10 (386 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 出会って5分は俺のもの！ 時間停止と不可避な運命
  • 英語名: Deatte 5-fun wa Ore no Mono! Jikan Teishi to Atropos

别名

  • The inevitable destiny opened by an Atropos watch

あらすじ

“Hey Mister”

Yuuma was walking to the station one morning, when he heard a voice behind him.

“I’m talking to you, Mister”

When he turned around, there was a small girl wearing black-themed clothes and hood despite the heat of early summer. She asked him if he was bored, and he dismissed her as a fortune teller or promoting some religious group. Then, to his amazement, everything around him froze as if time had stopped. At first he thought it was a prank, but he had no choice but to believe in it when he saw that animals also stopped in their tracks.

item.title: Kamidanomi Shisugite Ore no Mirai ga Yabai.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hulotte
  • 発売日: 2017-03-24
  • スコア: 7.0/10 (915 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 神頼みしすぎて俺の未来がヤバい。
  • 英語名: Kamidanomi Shisugite Ore no Mirai ga Yabai.

别名

  • 俺の未来は無理ゲーっぽい

あらすじ

“If you don’t tie the knot with the person of your dreams within the next year, you’ll be in big trouble.”

So forewarns Urara, the self-proclaimed Goddess of Matchmaking, when she appears before our hero Hajime Kanbayashi. Hajime’s your average youth, except that he’s been a little bit too into love spells and love charms in his goal to get more popular with the ladies. And this time, according to Urara, it’s this particular hobby of his that’s the cause for his current predicament—just like eating too much of a good food can make you sick, each spell, however trivial and cute, can prove disastrous if overused. To make matters worse, it seems that some of the spells Hajime tried were the real deal! Thanks to this, the law of cause and effect has been thrown out of whack and his future is looking bleak…

item.title: Imouto no Okage de Motesugite Yabai.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hulotte
  • 発売日: 2013-11-29
  • スコア: 7.18/10 (322 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹のおかげでモテすぎてヤバい。
  • 英語名: Imouto no Okage de Motesugite Yabai.

别名

  • Hard to be loved too thanks to my little sister

あらすじ

One year ago, Tokiya fell in love with Kanae at first sight. For the purpose of declaring his feelings for her, he underwent hell-like training from his younger sister Meguri and studied like mad to enter her school Seimatsurika Academy. However, Tokiya was quite the introverted person and didn’t have any confidence. Meguri suggested that he use the Asasaka family’s hidden technique ‘kokkai no gi’, which can make females attracted to him and give him a period of popularity, at the expense of the possibility of marriage in the future.
